images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front and northern side of the James J. Hinde House, located at 317 Fulton Street in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1894, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: James J. Hinde House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the James J. Hinde House (Sandusky, c.1910): a big Arts & Crafts house of round glacial cobblestones with a half-timbered and pebble-dashed gable, a row of red dormers, a deep porch on cobblestone piers, bay windows

why.note: Craftsman cobblestone: field boulders as a deliberate 'natural' finish
